maria-g: Heads up — docs deploy failed on staging. SVG logos 404 and some inline code snippets collapse on mobile after the parser swap. Not sure if it's anchor rewrite or the markdown plugin change. cc @docs-ci jonathan: Can you paste the page URL + a sample path? maria-g: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/reference/sdk/overview.html maria-g: Example snippet from repo: ```html ``` maria-g: On mobile the image disappears and the surrounding paragraph merges with the next code block. alexr: Looks like mkdocs used `/assets/` and Docusaurus expects `/static/` — but repo still has a bunch of relative links. try `git grep "assets/img"` to find them jonathan: also saw fenced code rendered without the surrounding 
 sometimes — markdown-it plugin order changed in the migration
steph-k: I can push a small script to rewrite common svg paths and enforce fenced blocks. quick patch I ran locally:
```bash
python scripts/rewrite_img_paths.py --src docs/ --from "assets/img" --to "static/img"
```
steph-k: will open PR for the path rewrites + add small css fix for mobile code wrapping
maria-g: awesome, can you include a smoke-test page and a screenshot in PR? staging renders look different across browsers
docs-ci: build #1284 failed: htmlproofer detected missing file /static/img/redwood-logo.svg on staging
jonathan: if you add a redirect in docusaurus config we can keep old links working until we fully rewrite
steph-k: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — includes path script + css tweak + test page
maria-g: reviewing now, will test on iOS Safari after merge :thumbsup:
jonathan: thanks — if it passes, we can schedule a quick follow-up to sweep other asset types (svg/png)
maria-g: noted, I'll add a short checklist in the PR description for image path types and mobile checks
